description: Qwen3.8-27B native TensorFold CUDA speedup track on one DGX Spark GB10 (sm_121). The target is TensorFold/Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-4bit at 22d8d538154e0e5b6f8dcb1fcc74a60a0798104c. The drafter is z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 at 50307d4c4cde6860d4eee73e2547cd786fe8e8a4. Each ranked run has 2 pairs: a serial-control leg with no drafter and a candidate leg that runs DFlash depth 1 with the pinned drafter. The pair score is prefill_gain^0.25 * decode_gain^0.75 with floors 0.93 (prefill) and 0.95 (decode); the run score is the mean of the pair scores. The timed token stream must match its pinned tape exactly. Only Vendor/TensorFold is editable. fixtures/qwen3_8_27b_tf_cuda_v1_track.json is the authority.
